name: kit.file_rename
description: Renames a brand file for AI to read. A blank title keeps the old one: a file AI cannot name is one it cannot use.
sql: update brandbase.brand_files f set title = coalesce(nullif(btrim(:title), ''), f.title) where f.id = :id and f.brand_id = :brand returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(f)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(f.updated_at)) as result
